title: CareSight AI
subtitle: REAL-TIME FALL DETECTION
sideText: DETECT FALLS. SEND ALERTS. SUPPORT SAFETY.
description: CareSight AI is a real-time fall detection system for elderly care and safety monitoring. Stream a live webcam or upload a video, and a YOLOv8 pose model tracks each person frame by frame, flags a fall the moment it happens, and emails an alert to a chosen contact. The Next.js dashboard runs on Vercel and talks to a FastAPI + YOLOv8 inference API on Render over HTTPS and secure WebSockets.
impact: Shipped a full end-to-end product, from model inference to a live public demo: real-time webcam detection over WebSockets, batch video analysis with progress tracking, and rate-limited email alerts. Tuned the ML backend to run on Render's 512 MB free tier with CPU-only PyTorch, single-thread serialized inference, streamed uploads and automatic job cleanup.

howItWorks.title: Capture
howItWorks.description: The browser streams webcam frames to the API over a secure WebSocket (/ws/detect), or uploads a video in 1 MB chunks for batch analysis.

howItWorks.title: Detect People
howItWorks.description: A YOLOv8n-pose model locates every person in the frame. Uploaded videos are resized to 640px and every 3rd frame is analyzed to keep inference fast on CPU.

howItWorks.title: Classify the Fall
howItWorks.description: A person is flagged as fallen when detection confidence passes 0.6 and their bounding box turns horizontal (wider than tall). Fallen people are boxed in red on the live feed.

howItWorks.title: Alert
howItWorks.description: On a fall, the backend emails the caregiver's address over Gmail SMTP with the confidence score and source, limited to one alert per minute per session to avoid spam.
